## Automated Tests Required

### hud-002 NE Postura+Vida jefe — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/ui/hud_ne_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- NE visible only in duel, collapsed outside (incl. duel re-entry)
- Postura −1 same tick the ev.8 entry transient shows (simultaneity, not sequence)
- `set_postura()` ignored while VE active (absence IS signature V6); resumes next tick after close
- Boss HP changes only on connected Castigo, exact bruto 30/40/50 (`vida_max_angel` 120/200/300 per tríada)
- Corrupt `combo_abortado` payload → RUNTIME_DROP + WARN + counter+1, no crash

**Edge cases to cover**:
- ev.8 at Postura 0 (Aturdido path, never negative)
- Overkill Castigo clamp; repeated Castigos
- Double-corrupt stream; valid-after-corrupt recovery

**Estimated test count**: ~9 integration tests

*No formula found in referenced design doc (UX spec, no Formulas section) — test cases derived from acceptance criteria + QL-STORY-READY specs. Review combat F1/R7 + IA D6 before writing tests.*

### hud-003 Timer S + freeze-ALWAYS + Pausa — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/ui/hud_timer_freeze_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- S bar continuous 120 ticks, Aturdido-only, show/hide no ease
- Freeze: HUD advances 60 ticks @60Hz while diegetic advances 0 (C14)
- Pausa: dim 40%, S hidden, timer value frozen, zero rumble, return by cut
- `physics_ticks_per_second=60` pinned (config grep gate)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Re-stun mid-count resets to 120; 119/121 boundary ticks
- Freeze opened during S-bar active; pausa opened mid-freeze (gating R12)

**Estimated test count**: ~8 integration tests

*Time semantics per ADR-001 Pattern-A. Never count with `_process` or pausable probes (Impacto D1 oracle rule).*

### M-004 Firma hold Tipo-A — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/menu/firma_hold_test.gd`
**What to test** (fake clock):
- `firma_hold_ms=1000` (range 800–1500): early release/cancel → 0 deletions, sha identical, 5-field list shown
- Incomplete Reset firma → byte-identical; full hold → PER+SUS deleted, SET intact → S0 + log
- Modal opens ≤100ms focus same-frame; focus-move ≤1 frame @60fps

**Edge cases to cover**:
- 1-flank tap; kill mid-hold; hold across 999/1000/1001ms boundary
- Modal open during splash (must queue, never pre-empt)

**Estimated test count**: ~7 unit tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### hud-001 NW Vida+Gracia — UI
**Verification method**: Manual step-through + screenshots @1280×800
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/evidence/hud-nw-evidence.md` (bar tracking captures, shard states, rg output, layout measurement)

Checklist:
- [ ] Vida bar tracks every mocked HP change in 1–2 ticks, hard cut, no ease-in
- [ ] Gracia shards below Vida, smooth interp, match Ledger ±1e-9 after settle (HUD never computes)
- [ ] Single #C75C4A flash on ev.5, exactly 1–2 ticks
- [ ] `rg` over NW assembly: zero hardcoded user-facing strings (all via `tr()`)
- [ ] NW bounding box ≤6% screen area, 5% safe-zone clear (measured)

### hud-004 Alertas + cola + vignette — UI
**Verification method**: Frame-stepped manual session
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/evidence/hud-alert-queue-evidence.md` (collision sweep log + captures)

Checklist:
- [ ] Pairwise same-tick collision sweep: exactly one flash, lower priority deferred 1 tick, all 7 levels hold
- [ ] Death ev.13 mutes everything 800ms exact; fail ev.5 mutes VE signature 200ms exact
- [ ] Low-HP vignette progressive tinta from edges, alpha-only pulse, zero light-flash frames
- [ ] Deck 40Hz frame-step, 50 trials: critical tick held 2 render frames, none lost

### M-006a Reduced-motion + legibilidad — UI
**Verification method**: Manual step-through + Deck session (ADVISORY gate)
**Who must sign off**: ux-designer
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/evidence/menu-motion-readability-evidence.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] Reduced-motion ON: 0 flashes, static vignette, bus-only sounds on every transition
- [ ] Proxy: 0 functional labels <18px base, 0 nodes outside 5% safe-zone
- [ ] Deck 7" @30–40cm readability checklist complete (combine with hud Story 005 AC-d session in Sprint 2)

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths before any QA hand-off for this sprint (`/smoke-check sprint`):

1. Game launches to main menu without crash
2. Duel scene loads via Core stubs with HUD visible (NW + collapsed NE)
3. Freeze triggers with HUD ticking at full speed (C14 spot-check)
4. Pausa dims HUD, freezes timer, returns by cut
5. Firma hold modal opens on demand; cancel path deletes nothing
6. Save/load untouched by menu assembly (MENU-08 oracle green)
7. Performance within budget, no new frame spikes on target path

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, video, or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for all Visual/Feel and UI stories
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions introduced
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
